BiblicalUsage: hálas means salt. In Matthew 5:13, the text says "Ye are the salt of the earth." In Mark 9:50, the text says "Salt [is] good."
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that hálas matters because purity is not prudishness; it is keeping ourselves for the God who made us. That is why I keep this word in mind when I read those passages — it carries more than its size suggests.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
